tutorial.joker: In Hasenpfeffer the **joker is the highest trump of all** -- the Best Bower. Next comes the jack of trumps (Right Bower), then the **jack of the same colour** (Left Bower), which counts as a trump rather than as its own suit.
tutorial.bidding: **Bidding is compulsory.** Once three players pass, **the dealer cannot** -- the pass button disappears in that case. Bids run from three to six tricks, and you must beat the standing bid to take the contract.
tutorial.blind: One of the 25 cards is dealt **face down**. Whoever wins the auction picks it up, making seven, then **discards one and names trump**.
tutorial.hand: Your hand. Playable cards get a green ring. While discarding, tapping a card marks it in yellow; choosing a suit then confirms it.
